workerContactConsent.publicProfileNotice: Existing public profile information, including your name, license/qualification type and general activity location, is displayed according to your profile visibility settings. This optional consent concerns phone-number sharing; refusing or withdrawing it does not hide your public profile. Turn off profile visibility separately to stop displaying your profile.
workerContactConsent.policyApplicability: The new contact-sharing disclosure applies to a member’s contact details only after the existing change-notice procedure, rollout to the service and that member’s explicit consent. Its version date is not a retroactive effective date, and existing members are not automatically opted in. We retain the consent decision, notice version and server-recorded change time.
workerContactConsent.items: Phone number, together with your currently shared name, license/qualification type and general activity location (not your exact home address)
workerContactConsent.retention: Hospital members must retain and use the information only until the recruitment/contact purpose is fulfilled or consent is withdrawn / the account is deleted, whichever occurs first. Legally mandated retention is excepted.
workerContactConsent.disclosure: Your number is masked in lists, but the actual number appears in the SMS/call app and can also be revealed by a desktop QR code. This is NOT an anonymous intermediary service. Your number may remain on the recipient’s device and in messages or call history.
workerContactConsent.withdrawal: You can withdraw anytime by unchecking this optional consent in Edit Profile and saving. Withdrawal blocks future access to your contact number through the site; it cannot remotely erase previously shared numbers or messages. The recipient retention obligation does not guarantee deletion of existing copies.
workerContactConsent.legacyNotice: Consent to the current contact-sharing version has not been confirmed. To receive recruitment contact from hospitals, read the disclosure, explicitly select the checkbox and save. You can save your profile without selecting it.
workerContactConsent.versionNotice: Contact-sharing notice version: {{version}}. The date in the version is not a retroactive effective date; it applies after rollout and your explicit consent.
workerContactConsent.saveUnverified: The saved contact-consent state could not be verified. Reopen your profile to check its status before trying again.
workerContactConsent.policyNotice: The disclosure for contact-sharing version {{version}} appears in Article 4 below. This version label does not imply completed deployment or retroactive effect.
workerContactConsent.refusal: You have the right to refuse. Refusal still allows signup and use of other services, but hospital members cannot initiate SMS/calls to you through the site.

consent.article1Body: These terms govern the conditions and procedures for using the Medinoti service operated by Smile-up Co., Ltd., and the rights and obligations between the company and its members.
consent.article4Body: To register, you agree to these terms and submit the required information in the prescribed form. Registration may be refused for false information, use of another person's identity, or applicants under 14 years of age.
consent.article9Body: Members may withdraw at any time, and some information is retained for a certain period in accordance with relevant laws.
consent.article10Body: The company has no obligation to intervene in disputes between members and does not guarantee the accuracy of posted information.
